query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM central.workflow_edges e JOIN central.workflow_nodes p ON p.id = e.prerequisite_node_id WHERE e.dependent_node_id = $1 AND e.kind = 'ordering' AND p.state <> 'succeeded')OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM central.workflow_edges e LEFT JOIN central.artifacts a ON a.id = e.artifact_id WHERE e.dependent_node_id = $1 AND e.kind = 'artifact' AND a.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready')
